name: capyquest
description: A pixel-art idle clicker RPG about a very relaxed capybara.
//: There are no dependencies and no build step. This file exists so Node treats src/ as ES modules when running the test suite; the game itself is served as plain static files. The vm-modules flag is for tests/modules.test.js, which parses every source file — including main.js, which needs a DOM and so is never imported by anything else.
